The '''Model 11 Space Suit''' was an [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]] manufactured by [[LifeLine Technologies]]. The suit included a [[heating unit]], [[waste recycler]], and its own [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] supply. The Model 11 could support an individual in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] for ten [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]].
